title: Hard Drive Framework
subtitle: Test your grasp of the Hard Drive Framework — The CUBE Containment as master frequency server, crystalline hard drives, perception overlays, eight primary domes, and the reboot that reveals the crystalline temple.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Hard Drive Framework is the structural foundation of existence: The CUBE Containment runs all maps, overlays, grids, and simulations as a multi-dimensional frequency server. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Hard Drive Framework deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. As enough souls achieve harmonic alignment, false overlays glitch and collapse — and the pure interwoven crystalline temple reboots into view.

questions.question: What is the primary function of The CUBE Containment within the Hard Drive Framework?

options.label: A
options.text: To serve as a multi-dimensional frequency server that houses and records all realities.
options.rationale: The CUBE acts as the central hard drive and framework for all domains, simulations, and soul memories.

options.label: B
options.text: To generate oxygen and biological life through a mechanical filtration system, treating the prison.
options.rationale: The framework processes sound, light, and motion to create the illusion of physical reality, but it is not a biological support system.

options.label: C
options.text: To function as a planetary weapon system used by external architects and ignoring the deliberate.
options.rationale: While it was designed by architects, its primary role is data storage, reality projection, and structural foundation.

options.label: D
options.text: To act as a physical barrier preventing souls from leaving the planetary atmosphere.
options.rationale: The CUBE is described as an electromagnetic frequency framework rather than a traditional physical wall or barrier.

questions.hint: Consider its role as the ultimate data storage and projection mechanism of creation.
